_description: Border ranks (approximate / limit-of-bilinear) for small ⟨n,m,p⟩ matmul formats. Distinct from exact rank (lower-bounds.json) — border rank R̃ allows ε-perturbation, giving R̃ ≤ R but the gap is often striking. Field-specific. Manually maintained; add entries as new border-rank results are published.

_schema.border_rank: best known upper bound on R̃(⟨n,m,p⟩) — the border rank
_schema.tight: true if upper == lower (exact border rank)
_schema.source: primary citation key — original paper announcing the result
_schema.notes: context, technique (Bini-style ε-decomposition, Strassen laser, …), comparison to exact rank

entries.notes: R̃(⟨2,2,2⟩) = R(⟨2,2,2⟩) = 7 over C. No border-rank improvement over exact rank for the 2×2 case.
First demonstration that border rank can be STRICTLY smaller than rank: R̃(⟨2,2,3⟩) ≤ 10 via Bini's ε-decomposition vs R(⟨2,2,3⟩) = 11. The seminal example for the laser method.
R̃(⟨3,3,3⟩) ≤ 19. Exact rank: 21 lb (Bläser 2003) ≤ R(⟨3,3,3⟩) ≤ 23 (Laderman 1976). Gap of at least 2 from R̃.
